explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration with this content. `posMap` is defined in the library itself (ChangeOfGroup.lean, line 81), not in Mathlib. It is ordinary change-of-group `groupCohomology.map` conjugated by Mathlib's `TateCohomology.isoGroupCohomology`. Mathlib's Tate cohomology file (`RepresentationTheory/Homological/TateCohomology/Basic.lean`) has no change-of-group maps for Tate cohomology, so it has no compatibility lemma between such maps and `tateCohomologyFunctor.map`. The theorem is a naturality statement about the library's own definition. Its proof combines naturality of the iso with `posMap_comp_isoGroupCohomology_hom` and `groupCohomology.map_comp`, which takes more than one step from a single Mathlib result.
